class.name: SubtitleValidation
class.brief_description: The result of [method Subtitle.validate]: the segments with problems.
class.description: Each list holds indices into [member Subtitle.segments]. A segment can be in more than one list.

method.name: get_problem_count
method.description: Returns the number of entries in all lists together.

members.member: Segments without text (only spaces count as empty).
Segments with more characters per second than the limit passed to [method Subtitle.validate]: too much text to read in the time they are shown.
Segments whose [member SubtitleSegment.end_time] is not after their [member SubtitleSegment.start_time], segments with a negative start time, and empty slots in the array.
Segments that are still shown when the next segment starts. Overlaps are allowed (two people talking at once), but often a timing mistake.

Dialog segments (not closed captions) whose [member SubtitleSegment.speaker] is not an id of [member SubtitleServer.speakers], for example after a speaker was renamed. Only checked when the project has speakers; ids ignore case.
